messages:
claire: Quick check 1: need final X + LinkedIn copy for the May webinar. Also want a 2-variant CTA test and clear routing for inbound signups. Who can pick this up?

diego: Ill do the X variants (short + thread). CTA A = 'Book a demo', CTA B = 'Watch replay'. Will include a pinned reply template.

ria: Ill handle LinkedIn long-form + carousel. Recommend hashtags: #LLM #Inference #Redwood. Also suggest we call out latency numbers in TL;DR.

claire: Good. For routing: HubSpot mapping needs utm_campaign=may_webinar -> hs_campaign, and tag leads with source=organic_x or source=linkedin. Also assign to Webinar SDRs if utm_campaign matches.

ops-bot: Heads-up: landing page scheduled deploy in 45m. Last chance to change CTA text.

diego: Pasting pinned-reply draft: "Thanks for the interest! Register here: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=may_webinar — our SDR will follow up."

ria: Ill add LinkedIn CTA variants to the doc at /campaigns/may-webinar/docs.

claire: Follow-up cadence: immediate DM (1hr) with calendar link, 24h email w/ replay, 72h nurture w/ case study. SDR scripts?

diego: Ill add two quick reply templates to the thread.

ria: Uploading LinkedIn copy now. Leaving notes on asset crops.

claire: Thanks all. Locking schedule for publishing (UTC):
- 2024-05-20 09:00 - LinkedIn carousel
- 2024-05-20 11:00 - X organic post + pinned reply
- 2024-05-20 11:15 - X thread variant B (engagement)
If no objections Ill set posts in 2h. :calendar:
thread_summary: Short coordination for May webinar social copy, CTA A/B, HubSpot UTM mapping, and SDR follow-up cadence.
